parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~146965~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SpotResource
parameters.description: The resource information of the spot instance to query.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone ID.

Default value: empty. If this parameter is left empty, all zones in the specified region are queried.
